annotations.title: What else did this launcher launch?

description: Every token a wallet launched on Robinhood Chain before, and what's left of each now. Pass a token (its launcher is found from its launch) or the launcher's wallet. Returns how many tokens it launched and when, its busiest day, and for the newest ones the liquidity left in each pool now (trading, thin or no liquidity) and whether the launcher still holds any; then who first funded the launcher with ETH, and the other wallets that funder sent ETH to that launched tokens too, with theirs. A wallet with 100+ launches or 25+ in a day is flagged as a launchpad's relayer or bot, whose record isn't one person's. From Fivebar's launch index of every Uniswap v3 and v4 pool on Robinhood Chain. Use for 'has this dev launched before?', 'serial rugger?', 'what happened to their other tokens?'. Facts, not a verdict on anyone. Premium: 2¢ a call from prepaid agent credits (3 free premium calls a day). Send your agent key as Authorization: Bearer <key>.
